title: File:Kuala Lumpur International Airport Destination Map.png
desc: This map shows the countries connected to Kuala Lumpur International Airport, as of February 2026. Blue: Countries with both passenger and cargo flights. Red: Malaysia (airport's location). Light Blue: Cargo-only countries. Yellow: Future countries confirmed to be connected.
